user.title: Luma dev access
user.description: Lets cloud development sessions SSH to the TV for a few hours at a time. Each request waits for your tap on your phone; Home Assistant then adds a new key to the TV and removes it when it expires (at most 8 hours).

data.tv_host: TV address on your home network
data.tunnel_hostname: Tunnel hostname cloud sessions use for SSH
data.cloudflare_client_id: Cloudflare Access service token Client ID (optional)
data.cloudflare_client_secret: Cloudflare Access service token Client Secret (optional)

data_description.notify_service: Only this phone's Companion app can approve. Requests show an Approve and a Deny button.
data_description.cloudflare_client_id: Handed to approved sessions so cloudflared can reach the TV's tunnel without a login.

finish.title: Two things to copy now
finish.description:
**1. Dev token** (shown only now). Add it to the cloud environment as `LUMA_DEV_TOKEN`:

`{token}`

**2. Home Assistant's key for the TV.** On the TV, append this line to `/home/root/.ssh/authorized_keys`:

`{authorized_keys_line}`

Submit when both are done.

error.not_a_phone: Choose a phone's Companion app notify service (notify.mobile_app_…).
error.cloudflare_pair: Enter both the Client ID and the Client Secret, or neither.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Luma dev access is already set up.
